entries.03b288606492dc66: Guided by SERVICE (dedication) and TRUST (trust) toward society, and under the corporate motto 'Seijitsu' (sincerity), it has set the purpose 'With ideas that resonate in the heart, bringing a fufutto smile to fleeting moments.' Under its 3-year medium-term management plan 'SMILE 2027', which started in April 2024, the company is pursuing brand value management to become a highly profitable company and aims to build a strong business foundation that is not swayed by changes in the business environment. For the current fiscal year, the company focused on 'countermeasures against rising costs,' 'reduction of losses,' 'creation of value' and 'strengthening of the management foundation'.

entries.21357563c92fa75a: It is a manufacturer that produces and sells daily household goods.
